crossRefs.note: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

translations.web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
translations.bsb: How long will you lie there, O slacker? When will you get up from your sleep?
translations.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
translations.asv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
